sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach sit top with 22 points from 10 games and have won 7 matches overall, though their form has been dented by that recent defeat. Alsager are struggling at the foot of the table with just 4 points and have lost their last four games, making this a favorable fixture for Sandbach to recover momentum.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, offering an opportunity to close the gap on leaders Sandbach. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth visit Eccleshall in an intriguing mid-table clash between two in-form sides—Eccleshall are unbeaten in their last game while AFC Bridgnorth have shaken off recent losses. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth in the table and recently on a three-game winning run, welcome Wednesfield Community at home on Saturday before playing at Brereton Social on Wednesday evening. Bilston Town face Foley Meir at home on Saturday, with Bilston's strong recent form (three straight wins) pitting them against inconsistent Foley Meir. Bottom-of-the-table Widnes Town travel to Brereton Social—Brereton have lost two of their last three, while Widnes remain winless all season. Market Drayton Town host New Mills, with both teams searching for consistency. Shawbury United are in freefall with six consecutive losses and face Barnton away on Saturday. Cheadle Heath Nomads continue their difficult season away at Telford Town. Finally, Crewe host Allscott Heath in a basement battle between two sides with poor records.
